popular_name: Conservatorship Termination — Conservatee's Right to Petition
case_relevance: Termination right: conservatee has the right to petition for termination at any time (§1860); if conservatee was isolated and denied access to courts or counsel, exercise of this right was effectively blocked
Jury trial right (§1863): applies to contested conservatorship hearings, including termination proceedings
